description: France's communes in a département (departement, e.g. "93"), a région (region, INSEE code, e.g. "11" for Île-de-France) or within radius_km of a place, ranked by the median price per m² of their recorded sales of a type (DVF, the latest 24 months), cheapest first, dearest first, by how it moved against the 24 months before (falling, rising), or by gross rental yield: each with its sales, the change, ANIL's asking rent per m² for the type, the gross yield, its population and distance. max_price_per_m2, or budget with surface, keeps the communes where that home is affordable. Paris, Lyon and Marseille by arrondissement.

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

budget.description: With surface: the price that home may cost, purchase costs aside.

max_price_per_m2.description: The dearest median price per m² kept.

min_sales.description: The fewest sales a commune's median needs (default 10).

order.description: price_asc (default), price_desc, falling (largest fall first), rising, yield (highest gross yield first).

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

radius_km.description: Around place, address or lat/lng: the radius in km (default 15, at most 60).

region.description: A région's INSEE code, e.g. "11" (Île-de-France), "84" (Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes), "93" (Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur).

surface.description: With budget: the home's floor area in m².

name: rank_communes
title: Communes ranked by price (France)
